before.name: Eleanor E. Stein
before.description: Daughter of New Deal economist Arthur Stein and civil-rights organizer Annie Stein. Joined Weatherman summer 1969; co-authored "The Bust Book" with Kathy Boudin. After the March 6, 1970 townhouse explosion helped Cathy Wilkerson disguise as fugitive. Went underground with Jeff Jones; their son Thai Jones born 1977. After October 1981 Bronx apartment FBI raid federal charges were dropped due to COINTELPRO illegality. Earned JD; became longtime NY State Public Service Commission administrative law judge and adjunct professor at Albany Law School.
